data.title: Bullshit Button as the meeting referee
data.creativeFamily: search-native editorial headline over a serious workplace scene
data.audience: Pinterest users saving funny coworker gifts, office humor, meeting survival, and unusual desk toys
data.hook: A restrained corporate presentation room gives one small red tabletop sound button the authority to referee the meeting, under the headline FOR MEETINGS WITH TOO MUCH CONFIDENCE.

product.name: Gemmy Bullshit Button sound-and-light desk toy (ASIN B000L70MQO)

references.lesson: Preserve the loose five-inch tabletop device: one glossy red hemispherical dome with the actual white uppercase product word, one low circular gray plastic base, and small black speaker vents. Exclude the retail package and pressing finger; never turn it into a mounted alarm, emergency control, detector, or giant game-show prop.

notes: Three product-derived concepts with stop feature, click feature, exact feature, fidelity risk, swap test, and proposed headline are recorded in the v10 README.
This product family has not appeared in a public Goose Gifts Pin.
The source listing is in stock at $8.99 and the canonical destination is indexable and self-canonical.
